//: Bundling-only view of the demo. It exists because `@rollup/plugin-typescript` decides whether to transform a module from its tsconfig's `include`, while the patch layer reaches the demo only through the alias plugin (`@cesium/engine/Source/Renderer/*.js` → `packages/cesium-webgpu/backend-webgpu/Renderer/*.ts`). Those files are outside `apps/demo`, so without this config they arrive at Rollup untransformed and the build dies with `Expected ',', got 'ident'`.
//types: `@webgpu/types` is required here (the demo's own tsconfig sets `types: []`) because the patch layer references WebGPU globals; the package tsconfig does the same for the contract-suite bundler.
